aim: SIGNula — a universal all-in-one CIAM / single-sign-on identity platform (PHP 8.4, MySQLi + prepared statements, MariaDB; Dreamhost shared hosting, no Composer in prod) providing internal accounts, MFA, passwordless, OAuth account-linking, passkeys/WebAuthn, a secure JSON REST API for first- and third-party service integration, multi-tier paid subscriptions, and full activity logging + data-protection tooling.

gate_ledger.title: SIGNula as IdP — SAML/OIDC provider + OAuth2 authorization server
gate_ledger.reason: Large architectural epic; today SIGNula only CONSUMES OAuth. Token-signing/key-rotation security-critical. Biggest single capability gap.

gate_ledger.title: Recurring billing / subscription lifecycle engine (#67)
gate_ledger.reason: Payment-touching (real charges, irreversible) -> Bucket-3; route via dev-team-stripe when approved. Engine scaffolded (BillingScheduler). B-007 placeholder payment redirects tied here.

gate_ledger.title: JWT API authentication (#41 / B-006)
gate_ledger.reason: Security-critical auth path + requires vendoring a JWT library (dependency decision). Overlaps G-001.

gate_ledger.title: Multi-jurisdiction compliance tooling (consent/age-gating/do-not-sell across 18+ regimes)
gate_ledger.reason: Requires legal judgement on which regimes/semantics. FG-002a (consent audit trail + DSAR tracker) is the autonomy-eligible slice built separately in COMPLETE.

gate_ledger_note: Remaining deferred gaps live in FEATURES.md and are surfaced/queued as COMPLETE reaches them: FG-006 push MFA, FG-007 SMS-OTP, FG-010 fine-grained authz, FG-012 SIEM streaming, FG-014 adaptive/step-up MFA, FG-015 partner SSO portal, FG-016 custom JWT claims, FG-017 impersonation, iLyricsDB #64/#65/#66. FG-013 WebAuthn signature verification is a SECURE-phase finding (auth-bypass risk), not a gate item.
